name: Solar array wing
brief: MK-001 Solar array on a sun-tracking mast. Round 2, matched to the pick: a framed equipment hut with a warm window on a wide dark plinth, a gunmetal mast rising through it to a slewing head with a green "power good" lamp, and two tilted wings of framed dark-blue cells. Diegetic: if the base is short of power, the lamp and the hut window go amber.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
